categories.name: ETF
categories.content: Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) is product that holds a basket of assets such as stocks, bonds, commodities, or crypto.

categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Camelot Launchpad
categories.content: Camelot Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: NFT Lending/Borrowing
categories.content: Individuals can use their NFTs as collateral to secure loans, or lend out their NFTs to others in exchange for interest, creating liquidity without the need to sell the NFTs themselves.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: Simulation Games
categories.content: Simulation game replicates real-world activities, offering players the opportunity to experience different skills or activities in a virtual environment.

categories.name: Poolz Finance Launchpad
categories.content: Poolz Finance Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Yield Aggregator
categories.content: Yield aggregators are protocols that collate multiple yield farms in a single place in order to ease the process of farming. With many new farms popping up on the market, it can be tedious for one to hop from farm to farm. However, with yield aggregators, that isn’t necessary as it’s done automatically in order to maximize the yield generated for users.

categories.name: DN-404
categories.content: The "Divisible NFT" standard (DN-404) aims to be a hybrid of ERC20 and ERC721 that could act as an NFT with native fractionalization built in.

categories.name: Bitcoin Sidechains
categories.content: Bitcoin Sidechains are designed to enhance the Bitcoin blockchain's capacity by creating a new layer that improves transaction processing speed by handling transactions off the primary chain.

categories.name: Cookie Launchpad
categories.content: Cookie Launchpad is a token sale platform operated by Cookie DAO that allocates participation opportunities in three pools: one for top users ranked by on-chain and social engagement ('capital mindshare' via Cookie Snaps), one for $COOKIE token stakers in higher tiers, and a public first-come-first-served pool.

categories.name: Racing Games
categories.content: Racing game involves competing in races with various vehicles. These games can range from realistic simulations to arcade-style fast-paced action.
